dispute.statement: I agreed to go round the jam near the start, but later he went off the route a second time without asking. I want that part refunded.

chat.text: Jam on Pan Island Expressway is building up ahead, can I go round via Bukit Batok West Avenue 3?

driver_statement: I asked about going round the jam and the rider agreed. The second turn-off was my GPS rerouting.
